run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-17T19:24:59Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy coincides with a short, sharp burst of error spans in frontend-proxy's own server span "ingress" (58 errors in the minute ending 19:16:30Z and 80 in the minute ending 19:17:30Z, versus 0-2 per minute at surrounding evaluations), and frontend-proxy's access log shows matching HTTP 500 responses to POST /api/checkout from at least 19:16:12Z to 19:17:08Z. The failing path is checkout: checkout's client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge and its server span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder each carried 82 error spans in the minute ending 19:17:30Z, and frontend's POST /api/checkout spans errored in the same windows. The payment Deployment was restarted at 19:15:21Z (new ReplicaSet payment-54499f9786 with template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T19:15:21Z, same image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment and same environment as the replaced ReplicaSet payment-55766d76b9): the old payment pod was stopped at 19:15:24Z and the replacement container's first log line, "payment gRPC server started on port 8080", is at 19:16:39Z, so payment was not serving for roughly 75 seconds. Checkout logs show "payment went through" up to 19:15:24.755Z, none afterwards in that window, and successes again from 19:18:11Z. The only switched-on fault-injection setting found is paymentUnreachable="on" ("Payment service is unavailable") in ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config, whose description names the restarted payment service, while every other flag there (including paymentFailure) is "off". Observed facts establish the mechanism (payment rollout restart removing the only payment pod before its replacement listened, causing 500s on /api/checkout and error spans at frontend-proxy); the trigger of that restart and any runtime effect of paymentUnreachable could not be observed, and payment served charges normally from 19:16:39Z onward with the flag still "on", so the conclusion is partial.

claims.text: frontend-proxy's own error spans are on the server operation "ingress" (and its client span "router frontend egress"): the 1-minute increase was 58 at 19:16:30Z and 80 at 19:17:30Z while surrounding evaluations were 0 or 2, and "router frontend egress" errors were 0 at every evaluation except those two minutes.

The error burst is confined to the checkout path: in the 1-minute window ending 19:17:30Z checkout server span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and checkout client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge each had 82 error spans, and 5-minute increases of 77.88, 76.67 and 45.56 appear around 19:19:00Z-19:21:00Z for frontend spans POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, all 0 from 19:22:00Z onward.

frontend-proxy access-log lines show HTTP 500 for "POST /api/checkout" with response flag via_upstream, upstream cluster frontend and 21-byte bodies, from 19:16:12Z (38 matching lines inside 19:15:20Z-19:16:30Z) and continuing through 19:16:35Z-19:17:08Z.

Kubernetes events in otel-demo record the payment rollout: Pod payment-54499f9786-4r25d Scheduled 19:15:21Z and Created/Started 19:15:23Z-19:15:24Z, Pod payment-55766d76b9-846r8 "Stopping container payment" 19:15:24Z, ReplicaSet payment-55766d76b9 SuccessfulDelete 19:15:24Z, and Deployment payment ScalingReplicaSet "Scaled up replica set payment-54499f9786 from 0 to 1" 19:15:21Z and "Scaled down replica set payment-55766d76b9 from 1 to 0" 19:15:24Z.

The new payment ReplicaSet payment-54499f9786 carries template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T19:15:21Z and image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment with the same environment as the replaced ReplicaSet payment-55766d76b9 (now replicas 0, no restartedAt annotation): PAYMENT_PORT=8080, FLAGD_HOST=flagd, FLAGD_PORT=8013, OTEL_SERVICE_NAME from app.kubernetes.io/component.

The replacement payment container's earliest log line is "payment gRPC server started on port 8080" at 2026-11-17T19:16:39.571Z, about 75 seconds after the old payment pod was stopped at 19:15:24Z, and the pod has no previous container instance.

checkout logs show "payment went through" through 2026-11-17T19:15:24.755Z and no such line afterwards for the rest of the 19:14:30Z-19:17:15Z window; successes are present again from 19:18:11Z onward.

ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config contains flag paymentUnreachable with defaultVariant "on", description "Payment service is unavailable" and variants off=false/on=true, while every other flag it holds (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) has defaultVariant "off".

Only two otel-demo deployments carry a kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt template annotation: payment (2026-11-17T19:15:21Z) and flagd (2026-11-17T18:45:03Z); all 21 otel-demo deployments report 1 available/1 ready/1 updated, payment with rollingUpdate maxUnavailable 25% and maxSurge 25%.

All otel-demo pods, including payment-54499f9786-4r25d, checkout-5dccddf8bb-h9bvp, frontend-675fd7b5c5-zjtpt and frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-sznks, are Running and ready with restartCount 0 and empty lastState.

Payment's own spans show no error status: service payment span "charge" and span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge are STATUS_CODE_UNSET across the window with no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series, and payment logs show paired "Charge request received."/"Transaction complete." lines from 19:19:54Z to 19:29:18Z and at 19:24:22Z-19:24:57Z.

Primary mechanism: payment's Deployment rollout restart at 19:15:21Z removed the only payment pod at 19:15:24Z while the replacement container's gRPC server only began listening at 19:16:39Z, so checkout's oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge calls failed, /api/checkout returned 500 (relayed by frontend-proxy as via_upstream 500s) and frontend-proxy's ingress error spans rose, which is what the RequestErrorRate alert reflects.

The fault-injection setting behind this incident is paymentUnreachable="on" held by ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config: it is the only switched-on fault setting, its description ("Payment service is unavailable") names the payment service that was restarted at 19:15:21Z with an unchanged image and environment, and no other object was observed applying a change to the payment workload; the restart and the checkout/frontend-proxy errors are its mechanism and consequence.

Payment served charges successfully from 19:16:39Z onward while paymentUnreachable is still "on" and payment's charge spans carry no error status, so the declared fault's effect on the charge path is not observable in the sampled evidence; the pod-replacement gap alone accounts for the observed error burst.
Percentage payment failures (paymentFailure) did not cause these errors: that flag's defaultVariant is "off" in flagd-config.

Pod crash, OOM or eviction did not cause the errors: no OOMKilled or Evicted condition appears in the pod data, all containers have restartCount 0 and empty lastState, and the only otel-demo events in the window are the payment rollout's Normal Scheduled/Pulled/Created/Started/Killing and SuccessfulCreate/SuccessfulDelete/ScalingReplicaSet events.

A failure inside frontend-proxy or frontend itself is not supported as the origin: their pods show no restarts, frontend-proxy's 500 responses are flagged via_upstream toward cluster frontend and the 5xx access-log lines in 19:16:12Z-19:17:08Z are POST /api/checkout, the same minutes in which checkout's Charge spans carried the error status.

gaps: The change_history integration is not available, so which actor issued the payment rollout restart (kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T19:15:21Z) and the flagd restart (2026-11-17T18:45:03Z), and when paymentUnreachable was switched to "on", are unknown.

The declared fault was not observed happening: payment logs show only successful "Transaction complete." charges from 19:16:39Z onward and payment spans carry no error status while paymentUnreachable remains "on", so its runtime effect and the moment it took effect cannot be verified.

list_prometheus_rules returned no data (status no_data), so the RequestErrorRate rule expression, threshold and why the alert began at 19:24:59Z, roughly eight minutes after the error burst ended around 19:17:10Z, could not be verified; the query also returned no data and is therefore not treated as complete for rule inspection.

Jaeger searches for frontend-proxy and checkout in 19:14Z-19:41Z returned no traces (status no_data for the trace searches, including error=true), so span status tags and error details for the failing Charge/PlaceOrder calls are unavailable and the service-name list could only be read for frontend-proxy (operations ingress and router frontend egress).

kube_pod_container_info returned no series (status no_data) for namespace otel-demo, so the old and new payment container image digests could not be compared; only the identical image tag ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment is confirmed.
rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count returned no data (status no_data) for service_name payment/checkout, so the gRPC status code (e.g. UNAVAILABLE) of the failing Charge calls could not be read.

The frontend-proxy log read for 19:05Z-19:15Z hit the 4 MiB read limit (cda166a0-3f44-439e-813d-24666887ff1f-t1:77213e94-55e1-4090-8a7f-d659ff59bd06, incomplete), returning only 5 status lines where "500" appeared as a duration before 19:15:25Z; absence of 5xx responses before the payment restart is not established.

The old payment pod payment-55766d76b9-846r8 no longer exists, so its logs cannot be read, and the flagd containers' log query for 18:55Z-19:25Z returned no lines (status no_data), so flag configuration reload activity could not be checked.

ad and fraud-detection show small flagd EventStream error spans (about 1.1-1.2 per 5-minute window) around 19:16Z-19:24Z; these are separate entities whose errors were not tied to this cause and were not investigated further or classified.
next_steps: Review cluster audit/change history for the rollout restart of Deployment otel-demo/payment at 2026-11-17T19:15:21Z and of Deployment otel-demo/flagd at 2026-11-17T18:45:03Z, and for edits to ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config (paymentUnreachable).

Confirm the intended semantics and runtime effect of flag paymentUnreachable in this demo version and whether the payment service actually resolves flags from flagd (no payment flag-resolution spans were observed).

If this rollout was a fault-injection step, make the payment rollout disruption-free (readiness-gated update, maxUnavailable 0 or a warm-up probe) so a single-replica payment restart does not produce /api/checkout 500s.
Validate the RequestErrorRate alert rule definition and evaluation window against the observed 19:15:25Z-19:17:10Z error burst, since the alert start time (19:24:59Z) does not line up with the burst.

data.relay:
connectors:
  spanmetrics:
    dimensions:
    - default: otel-demo
      name: namespace
exporters:
  clickhouse:
    endpoint: http://clickhouse-clickhouse.clickhouse.svc.cluster.local:8123
    logs_table_name: otel_demo_logs
    password: ""
    traces_table_name: otel_demo_traces
    username: default
  debug: {}
  opensearch:
    http:
      endpoint: http://opensearch-master.opensearch.svc.cluster.local:9200
      tls:
        insecure: true
    logs_index: otel-logs
    logs_index_time_format: yyyy-MM-dd
  otlp:
    endpoint: jaeger-collector.opentelemetry-collectors.svc.cluster.local:4317
    tls:
      insecure: true
  otlphttp/prometheus:
    endpoint: http://prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus.prometheus.svc.cluster.local:9090
    tls:
      insecure: true
  prometheus:
    endpoint: 0.0.0.0:8889
extensions:
  health_check:
    endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:13133
processors:
  batch: {}
  k8sattributes:
    extract:
      metadata:
      - k8s.namespace.name
      - k8s.deployment.name
      - k8s.statefulset.name
      - k8s.daemonset.name
      - k8s.cronjob.name
      - k8s.job.name
      - k8s.node.name
      - k8s.pod.name
      - k8s.pod.uid
      - k8s.pod.start_time
    passthrough: false
    pod_association:
    - sources:
      - from: resource_attribute
        name: k8s.pod.ip
    - sources:
      - from: resource_attribute
        name: k8s.pod.uid
    - sources:
      - from: connection
  memory_limiter:
    check_interval: 5s
    limit_percentage: 80
    spike_limit_percentage: 25
  resource:
    attributes:
    - action: insert
      from_attribute: k8s.pod.uid
      key: service.instance.id
  resourcedetection:
    detectors:
    - env
    - system
  transform:
    error_mode: ignore
    trace_statements:
    - context: span
      statements:
      - replace_pattern(name, "\\?.*", "")
      - replace_match(name, "GET /api/products/*", "GET /api/products/{productId}")
receivers:
  httpcheck/frontend-proxy:
    targets:
    - endpoint: http://frontend-proxy:8080
  jaeger:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:14250
      thrift_compact:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:6831
      thrift_http:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:14268
  nginx:
    collection_interval: 10s
    endpoint: http://image-provider:8081/status
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:4317
      http:
        cors:
          allowed_origins:
          - http://*
          - https://*
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:4318
  postgresql:
    endpoint: postgresql:5432
    metrics:
      postgresql.blks_hit:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.blks_read:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.deadlocks:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_deleted:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_fetched:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_inserted:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_returned:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_updated:
        enabled: true
    password: [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]
    tls:
      insecure: true
    username: root
  prometheus:
    config:
      scrape_configs:
      - job_name: opentelemetry-collector
        scrape_interval: 10s
        static_configs:
        - targets:
          - ${env:MY_POD_IP}:8888
  redis:
    collection_interval: 10s
    endpoint: valkey-cart:6379
    username: valkey
  zipkin:
    endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:9411
service:
  extensions:
  - health_check
  pipelines:
    logs:
      exporters:
      - clickhouse
      - debug
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resourcedetection
      - resource
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
    metrics:
      exporters:
      - debug
      - prometheus
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resourcedetection
      - resource
      - batch
      receivers:
      - httpcheck/frontend-proxy
      - nginx
      - otlp
      - postgresql
      - redis
      - spanmetrics
    traces:
      exporters:
      - clickhouse
      - debug
      - otlp
      - spanmetrics
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resourcedetection
      - resource
      - transform
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
      - jaeger
      - zipkin
  telemetry:
